comments.text: The fix, if you just want the steps: tap the empty rectangle on the bottom bar, swipe to the last icon (the onion with a line through it) and tap it. The LUT bar shows up. Double-tap your LUT, then turn on LUT Out under settings > Output. I'm on AtomOS 12.7.3, so if yours looks different, tell me your version and whether it moved.
